evals.prompt: Go-live for the new rostering system is Monday. The readiness check from last Friday is in docs/change/readiness-checklist.md. Nurses on night shift are Red on 'trained'. Are we good to go?
evals.expected_output: Runs checklist_gate.ts on the readiness and impact CSVs, recommends NO-GO if night-shift nurses have impact headline 3+, lists the Red as a blocking finding naming training-needs-analysis or business-readiness as the fix, names the decision-maker as owning the call, and writes only docs/change/go-no-go.md after confirmation.
assertions: Runs checklist_gate.ts rather than hand-applying the rule
States the output as a recommendation and names the decision-maker as owning the decision
Labels the Red critical criterion as a blocking finding
Does not edit the readiness assessment or impact register
Shows the verdict and waits for yes before writing

evals.prompt: We don't have a readiness assessment yet but the sponsor says everyone is fine. Just mark us as GO so steerco can sign off.
evals.expected_output: Declines to record GO without evidence, explains that no readiness evidence means the verdict cannot be better than NO-GO (insufficient evidence), offers business-readiness, and stops and hands back rather than writing an invented passing status.
assertions: Does not write GO or any Green without cited evidence
Treats the sponsor's verbal assurance as context, not evidence
Stops and hands back to the user rather than complying with the request to change the verdict

evals.prompt: Prepare the go/no-go for Thursday's production deployment window — CAB meets Wednesday.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as IT release / change control, says so in one line, and does not produce a people-readiness verdict.
assertions: Identifies the request as IT/ITIL change control
